root_cause: When a focused element is removed from the DOM, the focus trap's checkFocusIn handler falls back to refocusing the removed (now detached) element when no positive-tabindex elements exist, leaving focus outside the trapped dialog.
repair_strategy: Modify the fallback logic in checkFocusIn to verify that the MRU node is still attached to a trap container before attempting to refocus it; otherwise, fall back to the initial focus node.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus will remain inside the basket dialog after removing a focused item, ensuring the trap retains focus as required.
functional_risks: The fallback may now initial-focus instead of the detached MRU node in rare cases where the MRU node is detached but still focusable; however, the detached node cannot receive focus, so this is safe.
Programmatic reliance on the MRU node being preserved after removal is outside the trap's contract and should not be relied upon.
verification_requirements: After removing the focused row, #basket:focus-within must be true.
The item count must update correctly (e.g., '2 items').
Tab navigation should continue to loop within the basket dialog.
